lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular spots arranged in a non-linear, staggered grid posterior to the gills, with approximately five visible vertical columns of larger primary nodes.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, forming a regular lattice pattern in the mid-lateral region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single dominant horizontal linear feature is visible along the upper flank, exhibiting a pronounced vertical intensity gradient with high luminance on the dorsal side and a shadow-cast dark margin on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple Echeneidae (remora) specimens attached to the ventral surface and lower branchial region.
